content: React Native FlatList with inverted prop renders list bottom-up (newest messages at bottom). For SectionList (pipeline grouped by status): sections prop takes [{title, data}]. renderSectionHeader renders group headers. Pull-to-refresh via RefreshControl in refreshControl prop with onRefresh callback. Pitfall: inverted FlatList requires reversed data array order — newest message first in array. Use keyExtractor returning unique string. getItemLayout optimization for fixed-height rows. estimatedItemSize hint for virtualization. Do NOT use ScrollView for large lists — performance degrades badly.
